answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, capped per identity per epoch, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Every claim climbs the whisper of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the vine re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the terrace of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
